- Initial public release of resy-fpx.
- Query and manage Resy (resy.com) reservations entirely via shell with curl — no resy-mcp server needed.
- Supports full end-to-end flows: search venues, check slots, book/cancel reservations, manage favorites and Priority Notify.
- fpx CLI only required for one-time token bootstrap if Resy credentials are unavailable; otherwise, all ongoing actions are via API calls with curl.
- Suitable for script automation and environments without MCP installed.
